review_response_tasks.rationale: of label size与introduced后要求“标准化”名词，英美拼写均收。
their指pots，no two rims...perfect circle说明不规则这一特性或多处不规则；单数/复数均成立，regularity反义不合。
the...of this information要求准确性名词。
修饰disappointed，表起初；initial形容词不合。
reserve judgment/judgement until意为暂缓判断，两种拼写均可。
the...between两对象是区别名词；distinct形容词不合。

student_passage:
The (0) ARRIVAL (ARRIVE) of a new kiln gave a small ceramics studio an opportunity to change the way it labelled its work. Until then, visitors had found prices written on loose pieces of paper beside the shelves.

The studio introduced (1) ____ (STANDARDISE) of label size, so every price could be found in the same place. This did not mean making the pots look identical. The potter was proud of their (2) ____ (REGULAR): no two rims formed a perfect circle. Each label included the firing temperature, the maker's name and a short (3) ____ (EXPLAIN) of the glaze. The team checked the (4) ____ (ACCURATE) of this information against the firing notebook.

When a batch emerged with a slightly darker surface, the potter was (5) ____ (INITIAL) disappointed. In daylight, however, the colour revealed a depth that had been invisible under the workshop lamps. The studio's director reserved (6) ____ (JUDGE) until she had seen the whole batch. She then arranged the pieces by shade rather than by size. Visitors were told that photographs could not (7) ____ (RELIABLE) represent every colour on a screen. This warning helped them appreciate the (8) ____ (DISTINCT) between a digital image and the object in their hands.
